scope: A~130 collectivity evidence map: 131Ce, 133Pr, 134Nd, 136Nd, 136Sm multi-nucleus audit

ce131_li_singh.conclusion: Identical experimental lifetimes; apparent Qt difference fully explained by K=11/2 vs K=1/2 Clebsch-Gordan ratio.

ce131_trend.conclusion: No statistically significant Qt slope in 131Ce (z = -0.64); consistent with constant deformation.

pr133_trend_and_feeding.conclusion: Significant negative slope (z = -2.40) is coupled to 78.6x non-monotonic feeding delay jump; cannot be decoupled from feeding parameterization.

nd134_intruder_saturation.conclusion: Adding a second nu i13/2 intruder produces no increase in Q0; core centrifugal shrinkage saturates intruder polarization in A~130.

nd136_band_crossing_collapse.conclusion: 11-fold collapse of B(E2) at crossing caused by 4-quasiparticle alignment and wave-function mixing, not nuclear shape change.

sm136_band_crossing_step.conclusion: 10.4% step in Qt across crossing reproduced by 2-band mixing with Qt(14+) ~ 5.06 eb vs observed 5.38(34) eb.
